title: Openlands
label: Official ECHO Pack #2
subtitle: Relaxed building, farming, roads, and waystones
shortPitch: Build a home, follow old roads, restore waystones, and explore a gentler ECHO wilderness.
shortDescription: Openlands is the relaxed official ECHO block-survival experience for Native, Standalone, and NeoForge targets.
description: Openlands is Official ECHO Pack #2. It keeps the familiar gather-build-explore rhythm while using original ECHO content, relaxed defaults, forgiving shelter, recoverable death, HoloMap discovery, old roads, and waystone restoration.
